# Source-only; NOT_RUN. Flag checks of the server command for
# --execution-state. Every refused case fails before the server callback runs
# and before any configuration file is read: the targets and profiles files
# named here do not exist, and the state directory is never created.

# Help lists the flag.
skygo-kubernetes server --help
stdout '--execution-state'
! stdout 'server run called'

# The flag requires --targets, even when empty.
! skygo-kubernetes server --namespace tasks --execution-state $WORK/state
stderr '--execution-state requires --targets'
! stdout 'server run called'

! skygo-kubernetes server --namespace tasks --execution-state ''
stderr '--execution-state requires --targets'
! stdout 'server run called'

! skygo-kubernetes server --execution-state $WORK/state
stderr '--execution-state requires --targets'
! stdout 'server run called'

# The flag conflicts with --environment-profiles, either one empty.
! skygo-kubernetes server --targets $WORK/absent.yaml --execution-state $WORK/state --environment-profiles $WORK/absent.yaml --auth-file auth.json
stderr '--execution-state conflicts with --environment-profiles'
! stderr 'absent'
! stdout 'server run called'

! skygo-kubernetes server --targets $WORK/absent.yaml --execution-state '' --environment-profiles $WORK/absent.yaml
stderr '--execution-state conflicts with --environment-profiles'
! stderr 'absent'
! stdout 'server run called'

! skygo-kubernetes server --targets $WORK/absent.yaml --execution-state $WORK/state --environment-profiles '' --auth-file auth.json
stderr '--execution-state conflicts with --environment-profiles'
! stderr 'absent'
! stdout 'server run called'

# Existing named-target conflicts still apply with the flag.
! skygo-kubernetes server --targets $WORK/absent.yaml --execution-state $WORK/state --namespace tasks
stderr '--targets conflicts with --kubeconfig, --context or --namespace'
! stderr 'absent'
! stdout 'server run called'

! skygo-kubernetes server --targets $WORK/absent.yaml --kubeconfig $WORK/absent.yaml
stderr '--targets conflicts with --kubeconfig, --context or --namespace'
! stderr 'absent'
! stdout 'server run called'

! skygo-kubernetes server --targets $WORK/absent.yaml --context chosen
stderr '--targets conflicts with --kubeconfig, --context or --namespace'
! stderr 'absent'
! stdout 'server run called'

! skygo-kubernetes server --namespace tasks --environment-profiles $WORK/absent.yaml
stderr '--environment-profiles requires --targets'
! stderr 'absent'
! stdout 'server run called'

! exists $WORK/state
! exists $WORK/absent.yaml
